about.title: About NotThisDate
about.subtitle: Simplifying group scheduling, one calendar at a time.
about.mission.title: Our Mission
about.mission.p1: We believe coordinating group availability should be simple, fast, and free. NotThisDate was born from frustration with complex scheduling tools that require signups, have premium paywalls, or simply take too long to use.
about.mission.p2: Our approach is different: instead of asking everyone when they're available (which can be overwhelming), we ask when they're NOT available. It's faster, more intuitive, and gets you to the perfect date quicker.
